ask_yes_followup.text: Please give me an example of his/her pretend play. (If parent does not give a 0 example below, ask each individually.)

items: Pretend to drink from a **toy** cup?
Pretend to eat from a **toy** spoon or fork?
Pretend to talk on the telephone?
Pretend to feed a doll or stuffed animal with real or imaginary food?
Push a car as if it is going along a pretend road?
Pretend to be a robot, an airplane, a ballerina, or any other favorite character?
Put a toy pot on a pretend stove?
Put an action figure or doll into a car or truck as if it is the driver or 0enger?
Pretend to vacuum the rug, sweep the floor, or the mow lawn?
